summary: Iteration 72 comprehensive review of the two features shipped in this drop: (1) ticket attachments on user + admin support replies, and (2) required-field badges. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass on the live preview URL — PNG + PDF uploads succeed, roundtrip download bytes match the upload exactly, 11 MB rejection returns 413, .exe/x-msdownload rejection returns 415, empty file returns 400, closed ticket rejects with 409, ownership guard returns 404 for another user, admin_upload endpoint returns type='admin_upload' + uploaded_by_type='staff', and admin can download user_upload attachments. Unauthenticated admin upload returns 401. Frontend: signup badges render (First/Last/Email/Password → Required, Mobile → Optional), MySupport reply form attach flow works (paperclip button, native picker with correct accept types, pending chip with Remove, .txt rejected with 'Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF' banner, attach-only send enables Send, attachment appears in Attached block and message appears in timeline), and Admin reply form works too (Attach file button, 'Send Reply + N files' dynamic label, admin_upload row shows filename + admin_upload label + 'by staff'). One minor accessibility gap flagged.

issues: Password <input> has the HTML5 required attribute but no explicit aria-required="true". The other three required text inputs (First Name, Last Name, Email) all set aria-required='true' explicitly. For visual consistency + strict accessibility auditing, add aria-required='true' to the Password input (Signup.jsx line ~346).

action_items: OPTIONAL POLISH: Add aria-required="true" to Signup password <input> for consistency with the other 3 required text inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: support.py _persist_ticket_upload (line ~273): Solid design — validates ext OR mime against the allowlist, size cap enforced after read (10 MB), safe filename normalisation stripping non-alnum, inline base64 storage same as other Wayly file features. Attachment projection returned to clients correctly excludes file_b64 and storage_path. attachment_added event written for audit trail. LGTM.

support.py _stream_ticket_attachment (line ~346): Purged rows return 410 (with 'no longer available' copy) and missing rows return 404. Callers must have already guarded ownership — user endpoint does {ticket_id, user_id} lookup, admin endpoint skips per-user guard as documented in the docstring. Good separation.
support.py upload_attachment_to_my_ticket (line ~1130): status gate limits uploads to received/under_review/awaiting_user — matches product spec. Returns 409 for closed/resolved (verified in test).

MySupport.jsx addFiles (line ~444): Client-side MIME + extension double-check mirrors server-side ALLOWED_TICKET_UPLOAD_MIMES + ALLOWED_TICKET_UPLOAD_EXTS. Good defence-in-depth. Error banner copy exactly matches spec ('Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF up to 10 MB.').

MySupport.jsx sendReply (line ~485): Correctly allows send when either text OR attachment is present. Sequential (message → attachments) rather than parallel — a slower flow but avoids partial-failure ambiguity.
AdminSupport.jsx send button label (line ~880): Dynamic label 'Send Reply + N files' is a nice UX touch. Confirmed live.

RequiredHint.jsx: Well-designed component set (RequiredBadge, OptionalBadge, FieldLabel, FieldLabelText). Uses aria-hidden='true' on the visual badge while a sr-only span carries the '(required)' cue — good a11y pattern. Only nit: FieldLabel's outer wrapper is <label> when htmlFor is passed, but the required indicator lives outside the semantic input association — screen-reader users depend on the aria-required on the <input> for the announcement, which is currently missing on Signup's password input.
Reminder from prior iterations: server.py + support.py (2022 lines) + AdminSupport.jsx (1228 lines) all still exceed the 700-line file-size guideline. Non-blocking, pre-existing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Signup required badges verified, MySupport user upload+download+error banner+remove+send-with-and-without-text verified, Admin login+attach+dynamic label+attachment listing verified

If the trial30909 account state drifts (plan=free / expired) the login fixture will skip; verify state via memory/test_credentials.md before running.
